overloadMerges.semanticRole: Gets one attribute's value by name; optionally also fills the caller-supplied attribValue variable with that value in the same call.
overloadMerges.note: autoparse's generic group handling drops the per-member optional flag and defaults every member to direction:in; the parameter table marks attribValue '←' (out) and it is documented as optional (only filled if the attribValue variable arg is passed).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Gets the values of multiple named attributes at once by passing a collection of attribute names in attribColl, returned as an object keyed by attribute name.
